criteria_outcomes.criterion: preserve exact handoff needs and allowed record identifiers
mark missing capability matches with unsupported sentinel coverage

reviews.decision_reason: map_coverage preserves the eight allowed record IDs and maps exact need text to capability IDs, producing direct coverage only for the six supplied capabilities and unsupported sentinels for n06-r01 and n06-r07.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: rank unsupported needs before covered needs
use upstream provenance rank as primary ordering within each group

reviews.decision_reason: prioritize_needs inverts the unsupported flag by setting unsupported = coverage == 'direct'. The resulting priority table ranks covered direct items before actually unsupported needs, contrary to the declared role requiring unsupported needs before covered needs.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: construct recommendation from already-ranked first priority record

reviews.decision_reason: synthesize_recommendation retains the eight-row priority window and builds the recommendation from the first already-ranked priority record. The observed wrong top need is downstream of the inverted unsupported flag in prioritize_needs, not a local synthesis fault.
